note: Cards that play their pre-errata (original print) version. They keep their passcode, so saves, decks, packs, images and CPU logic stay valid; tools/build_android.py bundles the listed EDOPro script under the original passcode and campaign_expansion.py shows this text.

26202165.name: Sangan
26202165.desc: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Add 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

78010363.name: Witch of the Black Forest
78010363.desc: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Add 1 monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.

83555666.name: Ring of Destruction
83555666.desc: Target 1 face-up monster; destroy it, and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to its ATK.

87910978.name: Brain Control
87910978.desc: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

8131171.name: Sinister Serpent
8131171.desc: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can add it to your hand.

45894482.name: Gilasaurus
45894482.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When you do: Your opponent can target 1 monster in their Graveyard; your opponent Special Summons that target to their side of the field.

80604091.name: Ultimate Offering
80604091.desc: You can pay 500 LP; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster.

40737112.name: Dark Magician of Chaos
40737112.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. Banish any monster this card destroys by battle, instead of sending it to the Graveyard. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead.

43586926.name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
43586926.desc: During the End Phase, if this card was destroyed on the field and sent to the Graveyard this turn: Special Summon it from the Graveyard, and if you do, its ATK/DEF become 1000. You can only use the effect of each "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.

99173029.name: Spiritual Energy Settle Machine
99173029.desc: Spirit monsters do not return to the hand during the End Phase. Once per turn, during your End Phase, discard 1 card or destroy this card.

75043725.name: Emissary of the Afterlife
75043725.desc: If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Each player adds 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from their Deck to their hand. Each player who didn't add a monster to their hand must reveal their Deck to their opponent.

16226786.name: Night Assailant
16226786.desc:
FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.
When this card is sent from the hand to the Graveyard: Target 1 Flip monster in your Graveyard, except this card; return that target to the hand.

14878871.name: Rescue Cat
14878871.desc: You can send this card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Beast-Type monsters from your Deck, but destroy them during the End Phase.

29762407.name: Temple of the Kings
29762407.desc: You can activate Trap Cards the turn they are Set. If you control "Mystical Beast of Serket" and this card: you can send both to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand, Deck or Extra Deck.

82301904.name: Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
82301904.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster in your Graveyard. You can pay 1000 LP; send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the Graveyard, then, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card sent this way.

17484499.name: Exchange of the Spirit
17484499.desc: While there are 15 or more cards in your Graveyard: Pay 1000 LP; Both players swap the card(s) in their Graveyard with the card(s) in their Deck. Then, both players shuffle their Deck.

95727991.name: Catapult Turtle
95727991.desc: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the Tributed monster's ATK on the field.

61740673.name: Imperial Order
61740673.desc: Negate all Spell effects on the field. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 700 LP or destroy this card.

53839837.name: Vampire Lord
53839837.desc: Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap). Your opponent selects 1 card of that type from his/her Deck and sends it to the Graveyard. Also, if this card is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard by your opponent's card effect, it is Special Summoned to the field during your next Standby Phase.

61441708.name: Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
61441708.desc: If this card is destroyed by a card effect, Special Summon this card during your next Standby Phase. If you Special Summon this card successfully in this way, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

21593977.name: Makyura the Destructor
21593977.desc: During the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard, you can activate Trap Cards from your hand.

57728570.name: Crush Card Virus
57728570.desc: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 1000 or less ATK; Check all monsters your opponent controls, your opponent's hand, and all cards they draw (until the end of your opponent's 3rd turn after this card's activation), and destroy all monsters with 1500 or more ATK.
